main_text.p: rogaverit vero quifquam quæ tantarum irarum fit caufa; regerunt illico, trifti feveritate in vultu, torvo lumine, ingenio fævo, inhumano atque inquieto, iracundia, avaritia, fuperbia, ambitione, πολυπραγμωσύνῃ, injuriisque his illifve illatis hanc indignationem promeruiffe, adeoque ipfum D. Spanhemium hujus fortunæ omnifque univerfim odii effe fabrum. quæ, quo jure quave injuria dicantur non inquiro, hanc litem minimè facturus meam. Sufficiat narraffe quæ dicuntur, quemadmodum & D. Spanhemius in Epiftola, facta tantum narrat; atque obfervaffe hujus odii caufas non effe controverfias illas, quibus D. Spanhemius eas imputatas vellet.

In eo D. Spanhemius multus eft, ut demonftret diffidia hæc Ecclefiaftica in Belgio jam ante annum MDCLXXII. fuiffe orta, neque illi Anno originem debere, atque inibi tanquam fycophanta miserè vapulat Gelafius Major, quem id afferuiffe conatur Lectori fuo perfuadere. Verùm, nec Gelafius, nec Timotheus,

page.notes: Greek word in the line "πολυπραγμωσύνῃ" is set in italic in the original; the Greek is transcribed as printed. The date "CIↃ. IↃ. CLXXII." is read as MDCLXXII. The word "miserè" is printed with a grave accent. Section mark "·" after "imputatas" is a printer's mark, not text. "Anno" and the year numbers appear as printed in the scan.
